opportunities.summary: `source.md` contains the complete RFC 5322 specification (Internet Message Format). We need a **fully conformant email address parser** in Python that implements the complete ABNF grammar from sections 3.2 through 3.4, plus obsolete syntax from §4.4. opportunities.title: harbor: an external agent and a verifier that refuses to invent a reward
opportunities.summary: Part of #101. Last, and deliberately so — it is the piece that buys the least. An external `BaseAgent` (host-side, via `BaseEnvironment`) shelling out to a `napbench-trial` entrypoint, plus a verifier that re-emits a report this repo already wrote. Harbor's container is built and near-vestigial; what it buys is fan-out, a job layout and a registry, not isolation. **Done when** - No check, gate, score or attribution logic has moved into Harbor. - The verifier calls `rewardFor` and writes **nothing**, exiting non-zero, when it returns `undefined`. - `report.json` — status, error kind, per-check results, trajectory — is written to the job dir on every trial, measured or not. - The Python lives somewhere with a stated gate story: `test/architecture.ts`, Biome, lefthook and CI cover none of it today, and `CLAUDE.md` records what shipping outside a gate cost last time. - An ADR records Harbor-as-orchestrator and why the container is nearly empty.

opportunities.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
opportunities.summary: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 187200`. ### Notes The `d` character is already accepted by the token regex, so malformed-input detection still passes — the value is just never added. A fix should add the `d` unit and cover it with tests. /bounty $50
